notes.title: Boss Focus: MegaStomp
notes.content:
Hey Deathrunners!

Look out for [b]MegaStomp[/b]!

MegaStomp was created with bricks from evil buildings around the world, imbuing this monstrous creation with a hatred for humanity. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723425/757c82429034ad06039be8144e7356867c26a6a9.png[/img]

Initially created for trash disposal purposes in the maintenance section of the DEATHRUN TV studios, it become quickly apparent that MegaStomp would grab any opportunity whatsoever to squash studio staff. 

Eventually, no one would step near trash disposal for fear of being crushed to a pulp, so producers made the decision to invite MegaStomp into the DEATHRUN TV roster where it would be allowed, nay encouraged, to stomp as many contestants as possible!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723425/a65fedb1af181dfe73434b1d42e52faa4196ffa7.gif[/img]

So if you step into an arena with MegaStomp, be quick on your toes because MegaStomp is dying to turn you into paste.

notes.title: Boss Focus: Knight
notes.content:
Hey Deathrunners!

Just what you need when fighting for your life is a true Knight to step in and save the day, right? [b]WRONG![/b]

Knight is not here to help you, here's here to wreck you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723425/0fdc18d81d71c107c8468ca5384f9440993420ae.png[/img]

Finding a passion for the world of live-action roleplay, he slipped deeper and deeper into his evil knight persona, and eventually, the lines got blurred. 

His increasing brutality and strict adherence to, 'The way it was back then', resulted in Knight being banned for life from all live-action roleplay societies. At this point the circle was complete, and the Knight persona had taken full hold. He needed somewhere where he could vent his Arthurian bloodlust on his foes, and he found it in DEATHRUN TV.

When you face Knight, remember, he will give you no quarter - it's a battle to the death!

notes.title: Boss Focus: Eyeball
notes.content:
Hey Deathrunners!

With a beady eye on the contestants, Eyeball is no sight for sore eyes... Lets meet this gruesome boss!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723425/e8607b63f280fe484941deb02509c8c10c4916b5.png[/img]

Eyeball's true name is unknown, and legend has it that it was once ripped from the skull of some giant beast when the DEATHRUN TV producers where experimenting with inter-dimensional programming (The real housewives of Shanbudria Biinax 11.. It didn't take off, despite a compelling pilot episode). 

No one really knows exactly what Eyeball wants, or why it decided to stick around, but everyone generally figured that trying to find your way in an alien world after being ripped from your home in the eye socket of some beastly horror can't be easy, so cut it some slack.

As a Deathrunner though, Eyeball is in your way, and it has no intention of letting you pass.  Keep your eye on the ball as you step into the arena with this boss...

notes.title: Boss Focus: Goliath Grub
notes.content:
Hey Deathrunners!

Here's another roadblock for contestants on the greatest game show on earth, the hideous [b]Goliath Grub[/b]!

Found in a desert ruin by researchers, a tiny grub with razor-sharp teeth was captured for study but was diverted en route and found its way onto the black market.

Researchers for the show purchased the grub and brought it back to the DEATHRUN TV labs for experimentation. The idea was actually an ill-conceived green initiative to clone the grub and create an army of hungry grubs for eco-friendly cafeteria waste disposal.

As is often the case, things went in a different direction, and the tiny grub demonstrated an ability to grow when fed. Eventually, after devouring weeks upon weeks of cafeteria waste, the once-tiny grub was a true goliath! The green initiative was scrapped and the Goliath Grub became a DEATHRUN TV boss, ready to chow down on something a little.... fresher.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723425/f9d18e238e0eac7367fa646b399dddabe9bb7a81.png[/img]

notes.title: Boss Focus: EdBot
notes.content:
Hey Contestants!

It gives me great pleasure to introduce you to the future of game show entertainment! EdBot, Ed for short (i.e. you want to cut your run short), a heavily-armed walking tank. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723425/066329b75406d9f9b5b9335ed00cf98abee0a2d1.png[/img]

EdBot had a brief stint as hired protection of sorts in the corporate world but things didn't really work out and EdBot was left looking for a new purpose. 

EdBot came across DEATHRUN TV and stopped by the studio to see about getting involved. This caused quite a panic in the studio until the producers realised they had simply to hide upstairs.

Offering a recurring spot on DEATHRUN TV was exactly what EdBot was looking for and it happily took up the post of a stage boss awaiting challengers to stop dead in their tracks. 

Don't get any ideas about 20 seconds to comply, EdBot is gunning for you the moment you step into its arena, and there are no stairs in the arena...

notes.title: Boss Focus - Crash Test Dummy
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We're here to introduce you to another of the many bosses who are just waiting for fresh contestants to wreck in the DEATHRUN TV studio.

The crash test dummy began as a contestant on DEATHRUN TV, but was terrible. His chances of winning an episode were astronomically low, but no matter how hard he was knocked down, he always came back for more. Eventually, he was brought back from so many absolute wrecks that his body began to undergo a change...

After a particularly devasting (and crowd-pleasing) death, his resurrection shocked the lab technicians when he emerged completely changed.

His old life was over, but he found what he always wanted, a starring role on DEATHRUN TV...

notes.title: Introducing: Commando
notes.content:
Hey Deathrunners!

As you battle your way through the studios of the greatest game show on earth, you'll come across some of the challenging bosses that are lying in wait, ready to ruin your run.

One of these is [b]Commando[/b], a former contestant that has become addicted to the monster crushing, mutation 'roiding thrill of the hunt!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723425/85dd83647344b15c8ca9c60374e59914003b4cd0.png[/img]

As a fan favourite, the producers of DEATHRUN TV turn a blind eye to Commando's favourite hobby of invading other contestants episodes. He's a former contestant himself, rising through the ranks with his personal mantra, "If it bleeds, I'll kill it".

He's taken a particular liking to you, the player, which means he'll plan to kill you last, as he sees the two of you as friendly rivals locked in an endless cycle of macho beefcake heroism. 

So get locked and loaded and prepare to say Hasta La Vista to Commando.

Stay tuned because we're going to give you a heads-up on more of the dangerous foes who are waiting to trade bullets with you in DEATHRUN TV, We'll be back!

notes.title: Play The Brand New Demo Now!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

[h1]A brand-new demo![/h1]

The studio has been reset, the audience is waiting, all that is left is you, the contestant! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723425/f216a2e436d43a75035c663f17ed87aa9a05be00.png[/img]

Dive into the new demo for DEATHRUN TV and unleash mayhem on the greatest TV show in the world. 

With every run, you edge towards exciting [b]new skills and weapon unlocks[/b] to wreak havoc on the many, many obstacles out to get you.

[h1]Twitch Integration - Take your seat in the studio audience![/h1]

Not only can you be the player, but you now you can also take part in the DEATHRUN TV audience experience! Watch your favourite streamers playing the game and [b]impact what is happening right from the Twitch chat![/b]

Will you [b]spawn a monstrous avatar of yourself[/b], complete with your Twitch username, right into the streamer's game and watch them do battle?

Will you perhaps grant the streamer a boon in the form of [b]invincibility or hyperspeed[/b]?

Maybe you just want to watch the world burn and [b]unleash a never-ending horde of enemies[/b] on the unsuspecting streamer. 

[b]Next time you hop into a Twitch stream, type the following into chat at the beginning of a round to get involved![/b]

[b]#saveme[/b]
You spawn into the game as a prisoner that the contestant can choose to save, or leave to die.

[b]#spawn[/b]
You spawn into the game as a monster. Will you kill the contestant, or will they kill you?

[b]#like[/b]
You love the contestant. Give them loads of likes to increase their score

At the start of each round, views can vote on a “powerup” that changes how the round plays by typing [b]#A, #B, #C[/b], or [b]#D[/b]. Sometimes these powerups are positives, some negative.
[list]
[list]
[*] Invincibility – the player cant be killed.
[*] Bullet time – Become 'the one' as the world slows down around you.
[*] Massive- the player gets huge, a bigger target but you can crush enemies beneath your feet!
[*] Tiny – the player becomes teeny tiny, a smaller target!
[*] Mega-Damage – player does mega damage.
[*] Horde – Hundreds of weak enemies spawn constantly.
[/list]
[/list]
[b]The world is your oyster, go and cause some trouble![/b]

[b]Are you a streamer brave enough to put your fate in the hands of the audience?[/b]
Connecting DEATHRUN TV to your Twitch account is as simple as [url=https://twitchapps.com/tmi/]generating an OAUTH token from here[/url] and connecting with your Twitch account name. There are a few options to allow you to customise how often the players can interact with you, we would love to hear your feedback on this as a Streamer!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723425/70960e4f6f95b47836b8f084939ae41b473f740c.png[/img]

Player feedback is always incredibly valuable to us so be sure to let us know what you think! if you come across any bugs we would welcome your bug reports [url=https://airtable.com/shrPtU41WmLt0BCBR]right here[/url]. 

Join the DEATHRUN TV Community in the [url=https://discord.gg/deathruntv]official Discord Server[/url].

notes.title: Hotfix #3
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Fancy a bit of DEATHRUN TV this weekend?

Well lucky you, the devs at Laser Dog have been hard at work actioning feedback, adjusting the studio lights and come up with another update to the pilot episode!

[u][b]Here's a lit of all the changes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Tap roll to cancel slow-mo in roll.
[*] Enemies receive 3x the damage from explosions that players do.
[*] Added interactable UI prompts.
[*] Increase the size of the weapon UI and made the bars scale from the middle.
[*] Fixed duplicate mutations appearing in the mutation selection screen (Allowing all mutations on this screen).
[*] Tweaked weapon 'charge' UI to show when you're almost out of charge.
[*] Managed the replicate the issue where a buzzer doesn't enable when you kill all enemies and fixed. Hoping that was the only case but keeping our eye on it!
[*] Prevent pausing on death screen.
[*] Added invulnerable time when hitting certain things such as slime trails.
[*] Made bloom work again - for targetting enemies.
[*] Fixed gameplay controller screen being active during pause/mutation screen.
[*] Prevent rockets exploding in walls when shooting next to a top wall
[*] Greater 'safe spawn area' in arenas.
[*] 2.6D?
[*] Bigger - closer weapon UI.
[*] In game UI on pickups.
[*] Fix grenade pickup and better grenades.
[*] Balance and difficulty tweaks.
[*] Slight buff on gold weapons.
[*] Weapon tweaks.
[/list]
As always we are so grateful for the amazing feedback and love hearing how much fun you're having with the demo.

If you haven't already, head over to the Discord and join the growing community of Deathrunners!

notes.title: Hotfix #2
notes.content:
Hey deathrunners!

What a few days it's been! We're blown away by the love for the pilot episode and the creative ways you have been challenging yourselves to complete the demo.

There's no secret ending, honest. We wouldn't lie about this. Don't worry about anything you hear about golden keys and secret doors...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723425/37d027b1f7beb035fea45ebd098e69849d5f50b9.jpg[/img]

Anyway... We've been hard at work going through the [b]incredible[/b] feedback you have all been sharing, so here is the list of updates in Hotfix #2

[u][b]Changes[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Rebalanced health, armour and damage systems. Enemies can do more than 1/2 heart damage.
[*] Fixed typo in death screen.
[*] Tightened up the roll mechanic.
[*] Fixed issue with sprite atlases showing overlapping sprites in UI.
[*] Prevent level gen placing objects inside boss lift.
[*] Prevent razers from moving when player is in spawn state.
[*] Shoot razers to change their direction.
[*] Made the out wall of level indestructible (5 cells from edge).
[*] No grenades on start, because who doesn't like a challenge?
[*] Grenades now explode when they hit an enemy.
[*] Various big fixes.
[*] Added lite shotgun.
[*] Laser pointer on Hitscan enemies.
[*] Added all mutations into "mutation UI".
[*] Tutorial - added pickupequip item.
[*] Tutorial - added swap equip item moment.
[*] Tutorial - added proximity mine moment.
[*] Spawner zombies no longer spawn directly on player.
[*] Difficulty / Balance tweaks - Champion bosses.
[*] Difficulty / Balance tweaks - Monsters
[*] Difficulty / Balance tweaks - Weapons
[/list]

If you haven't already please come and join the [url=https://discord.gg/deathruntv]Discord server[/url] and the growing community of deathrunners!

We [b]LOVE[/b] your feedback, so please, please keep it coming.

Thanks and have fun!

notes.title: Welcome to DEATHRUN TV
notes.content:
We are incredibly excited to reveal [b]DEATHRUN TV[/b], from indie developer Laser Dog!

DEATHRUN TV is the greatest game show on earth, a breakneck speed, bullet dodging action rogue-like.

Broadcast live from the largest TV studio ever created contestants risk it all to gather likes from the audience!

[u][b]Game Features[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Contestants who rack up those likes and level up their likeability can choose from a range of mutations to take with them on their run and change up the gameplay.
[*] 
[*] Met a grisly end on your run? Not to worry! State of the art proprietary technology means death is merely a brief inconvenience before you come back to try again, again and again!
[*] 
[*] Contestants can take on a run solo, but mayhem is more fun with friends, right? Get up to three friends together and wreak havoc in 1-4 player local multiplayer.
[*] 
[*] Like any good gameshow, DeathRun TV engages the audience. Viewers around the globe on Twitch can vote on the challenges you face and affect your run in a variety of ways.
[/list]
[url=http://discord.gg/deathruntv]Join the DEATHRUN TV Discord[/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1591690/DEATHRUN_TV/?utm_source=steam_community&utm_medium=community_post&utm_campaign=drtv_community&utm_content=announce_trailer]Add DEATHRUN TV to your wishlist![/url]

Check out the [url=https://youtu.be/inQBA65Au3w]launch trailer[/url] below, exclusively revealed at the Future Games Show, and remember, the run is all that matters…


[url=https://youtu.be/inQBA65Au3w][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723425/6f95fc33e31f0534704287350499b7d6a806321a.jpg[/img][/url]
